<!-- pr-reviewer: c39e6504303b350ca541476df266a07aede0204f -->
Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**
- The fix is small. It changes one function, `cargo_profile_dir` in `crates/post/src/data_dir.rs`.
- The new marker is narrow. A folder counts as a cargo profile folder only if it holds `.fingerprint` or `build/camcraft-post`. The path `.../build/<pkg>/<hash>/out` maps to the profile folder only when the third parent is named `build`.
- An installed exe is still refused by name. A user folder holds `build/camcraft-post` only by a very rare accident.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2316-data-dir-new-layout.md` is complete. The diff adds no CR bytes.
- The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #2316`. The PR changes no process file.

**Results, merged with main (local, Windows, `-j 6`, `--test-threads=6`)**
- `camcraft-post` lib `data_dir`: 11 passed.
- `camcraft-app` `shipped_from_disk`: 3 passed.
- `camcraft-app` `golden_cl`: 33 passed.
- `camcraft-app` `post_not_judged`: 4 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation check: I removed the new `build/camcraft-post` marker. The test `the_new_cargo_build_dir_layout_finds_the_repository_assets` then failed with `left: []`. I restored the file.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The local cargo uses the old layout. The real new layout is proved only by the next post-merge run.
- The comment at `crates/app/src/posting.rs:174` says a missing default machine file "refuses the post downstream". I found no such refusal. I will report this to the maintainer as a separate item. This PR does not cause it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
